name: Magnesium Ribbon
semanticDescription: A thin strip of elemental magnesium metal as used in the CBSE Class 10 'burning of magnesium ribbon' experiment, shown as a gently wavy strip.
simplifications: Thickness exaggerated from ~0.1 mm (real ribbon) to 1.5 mm so the strip remains visible at educational camera distances; the exaggeration must not be read as physical scale.
Wavy-strip shape approximates how rolled magnesium ribbon unwinds; it is not an exact model of any specific commercial ribbon.
